title: Liquid Network Security Incident
summary: Consensus-critical range-proof verification cache flaw in Elements software resulting in unauthorized creation of unbacked L-BTC and extraction of Bitcoin mainnet reserves via peg-out, followed by partial fund return.

verified_on_chain: Liquid exploit transaction f24a4b179b5cc7e88b25a763911f7cbdf2bf45d1d1b5ab611e94461cef0a183f confirmed in Liquid block 4,050,336 accepted unbacked L-BTC outputs.
Bitcoin peg-out transaction 8db751a650ae2f12006b7e8c69a75e4df360e8afd6b9e05ae0b9fa6458a7b140 confirmed in Bitcoin block 965,783 releasing 3,996.02 BTC from federation reserves.
Bitcoin return transaction a6d697a25266ce3c78774fd1d75f896b7af522ada209b0f6228ea497bc49a46d confirmed in Bitcoin block 965,950 returning 3,400.00 BTC to federation address.
On-chain message 'we are whitehats. contact us on chain.' confirmed in Bitcoin block 965,818 (txid c103de95817b43f2df635ec6f35ff126ca26a7c6d20570c4b01866b2b3e69a19).
On-chain response 'Please contact security@blockstream.com.' confirmed in Bitcoin block 965,822 (txid 91271efcbb5ab29abfc38ae635f0644e3ba042aad56f92d40136e1dde4742fe8).
officially_attributed: Blockstream assessment attributes exploit to range proof verification cache key collision in Elements software.
SideSwap confirmed no private key or Peg-out Authorization Key (PAK) compromise occurred.
Liquid federation bridge nodes were halted at September 6, 2026 18:26 UTC to contain further withdrawals.
Elements PR #1600 merged to implement length-framed CHashWriter cache key serialization and -norangeproofcache option.
reported: Security research firms reported peak affected assets of approximately $320M USD at market prices during the exploit.
Blockstream official assessment reported approximately 602 BTC remained outstanding as of September 23, 2026.
heuristic: Analysis of intermediate peg-out outputs indicates multi-hop forwarding behavior typical of automated liquidity aggregation.
unknown: Real-world identity and legal jurisdiction of the exploit actor.
Whether the actor's self-identification as 'white hat' represents genuine ethical intent or strategic negotiation posturing.
Final resolution or recovery status of remaining ~602 BTC beyond the September 23 assessment cutoff.

technical_findings.area: Confidential transaction range proof verification cache
technical_findings.summary: Distinct proof-related input tuples produced the same byte-concatenated cache-key input because fields were concatenated without unambiguous length framing.
technical_findings.root_cause_details: The secp256k1 rangeproof verification cache serialized key data by raw concatenation without explicit length prefixes. This permitted crafting input parameters that collided with existing cached verification entries, causing invalid unbacked outputs to be treated as valid.
technical_findings.fix_summary: Replaced raw byte concatenation with CHashWriter/SER_GETHASH explicit field framing and introduced the -norangeproofcache option.
